cues.zh: 精准命中会引发连锁反应，从而摧毁整个空间站。只有
cues.en: A precise hit will start a chain reaction which should destroy the station. Only a

cues.zh: 精准命中才会引发连锁反应。目标区域只有2米宽。
cues.en: precise hit will set up a chain reaction. The target area is only 2 meters wide.

cues.zh: 从4万英尺高空投下一枚10吨重的炸弹，它会直接扎进
cues.en: Drop a 10 ton bomb from 40,000 feet that would seal itself in

cues.zh: 墙体根部。那冲击波会极其巨大，
cues.en: the roots of the wall. Well the shock waves would be tremendous,

cues.zh: 简直就像一场大地震。但你能从8英里高空命中那么小的目标吗？
cues.en: a real earthquake. But could you hit a target that size from 8 Miles up?

cues.zh: 切换到瞄准计算机。
cues.en: Switch to targeting computer.

cues.zh: 你的投弹手眼睛紧贴着这个小瞄准孔，
cues.en: Your bomb aimer keeps his eye to this little peephole,

cues.zh: 当准星臂末端的这两个标针与塔楼完全对齐时，
cues.en: and when these two nails at the end of the arms are in direct alignment with the towers,

cues.zh: 你距离墙体就刚好是600码，然后投下炸弹。
cues.en: then you'll be exactly 600 yards from the wall and away goes your bomb.

cues.zh: 各战机汇报。好的，队长。红6就位。红3就位。我
cues.en: All wings report in. Okay leader. Red 6 standing by. Red 3 standing by. I’m

cues.zh: 到了，队长。在呢，队长。红2就位。在呢，队长。红5就位。在呢，队长。
cues.en: here leader. Here leader. Red 2 standing by. Here leader. Red 5 standing by. Here leader.

cues.zh: 看看那东西的个头！
cues.en: Look at the size of that thing!

cues.zh: 天哪，真够大的，是吧？咱们真能把它炸开吗？
cues.en: My goodness it's big isn't it? Can we really break that?

cues.zh: 我要横穿轴线，试着吸引他们的火力。
cues.en: I'm going to cut across the axis and try and draw their fire.

cues.zh: 你进攻的时候，我会飞越水坝，
cues.en: I'll fly across the dam as you make your run and

cues.zh: 试着把防空火力引开。好，谢谢领队。
cues.en: try and draw the flak off you. Okay, thanks leader.

cues.zh: 这里是Gold leader。我们开始进攻了。
cues.en: This is Gold leader. We're starting our attack run.

cues.zh: 我要进去攻击了。
cues.en: I'm going in to attack.

cues.zh: Gold Five，你觉得有多少门炮？大概20门吧，有些在地面上，有些在塔上。
cues.en: How many guns do you think Gold Five? Say about 20 guns, some on the surface some on the towers

cues.zh: Trevor，你觉得有多少门炮？我估计大概有10门
cues.en: How many guns you think there are Trevor? I’d say there’s about 10

cues.zh: 炮。有些在阵地上，有些在塔上。
cues.en: guns. Some in the field and some in the towers.

cues.zh: 太晚了Skipper。我能稳住。拉起来！
cues.en: It's too late Skipper. I can hold it. Pull up!

cues.zh: 现在应该能看到了。
cues.en: Should be able to see it by now.

cues.zh: 我估计你现在应该能看到了。
cues.en: I reckon you should be able to see it by now.

cues.zh: 稳住，稳住。
cues.en: Steady, steady.

cues.zh: 发射了！命中了！不对，不对。没打进去。只是打在了表面上。
cues.en: It's away! It’s a hit! Negative, negative. It didn't go in. Just impacted on the surface.

cues.zh: 没了，我们成功了！还没呢，它还在那儿。
cues.en: It's gone we've done it! We haven't. It's still there.

cues.zh: 呼叫，我的右舷引擎刚熄火了。
cues.en: Hey there, I just lost my starboard engine.

cues.zh: 嘿 Popsy，你们中弹了吗？右翼中弹了。但我们没事，能撑住。
cues.en: Hey Popsy, are you hit? Starboard wing. But we're all right, we can make it.

cues.zh: 最后一颗炸弹在你手上，Les，稳着点来。
cues.en: You've got the last bomb Les, so take your time.

cues.zh: 不见了，快看！我的天啊！
cues.en: It's gone, look! My God!
